English Sign Language!

Learn 10 signs with your hands 👋

Instructions

Let's learn to talk with our hands! 👋💬

1. Watch each sign and try it with your own hands.

2. After learning all 10, play Guess the Sign! to test your memory.

3. Then race the clock in Sign Race!

Sign 1 of 10
Hello
💡 Hold your flat hand near your forehead, then move it outward like a little salute!
Sign 2 of 10
Thank You
💡 Touch your fingertips to your chin, then move your hand forward and down.
Sign 3 of 10
I Love You
💡 Stick out your thumb, pointer finger, and pinky finger all together!
Sign 4 of 10
Please
💡 Rub your flat open hand in a circle on your chest.
Sign 5 of 10
Sorry
💡 Make a fist and rub it in a circle on your chest.
Sign 6 of 10
Yes
💡 Move your fist up and down, like a little nodding head!
Sign 7 of 10
No
💡 Tap your thumb, pointer, and middle finger together a couple of times.
Sign 8 of 10
Friend
💡 Hook your two pointer fingers together, then swap which one is on top!
Sign 9 of 10
Clapping
💡 Clap your hands together!
Sign 10 of 10
Happy
💡 Brush your open hands upward on your chest, like happy feelings rising up!
